description: This file defines the PrivilegeListener interface used in the OpenMRS system. It is designed for tracking privilege checks during user authorization processes, providing a hook for logging or auditing privilege checks within the system.

classes.name: PrivilegeListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to privilege check events during user authorization, allowing implementations to respond whenever a privilege is checked.

methods.name: privilegeChecked
methods.description: Callback method invoked whenever a privilege check occurs, providing details about the user, privilege, and whether the user has the privilege.
